summary: Borr Drilling filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a press release updating the Prospector 5 rig incident offshore Gabon first disclosed October 25, 2026. Of 115 personnel aboard, 110 returned ashore; an ROV located three deceased individuals, with two still unaccounted for and recovery/search ongoing. Roughly 280 cubic meters of marine diesel were aboard, with mitigation coordinated with the customer and local authorities. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership/regulatory mechanics are stated; this is an operational incident update, not a special situation.
